$comment: The one sentence of every chart (CLAUDE.md invariant 8; work order 3, lane A, item 2). Each is a template: src/lib/chartSentence.ts works out one fact from the figures the chart draws and fills it in, and a sentence that cannot be filled, or that rests on a figure the chart withholds, is dropped, never softened. A template names no domain value, figure or year and says what the data shows, never why. The sentence of a chart that counts only some of the vehicles (a condition the visitor set, or one its field implies) says so at its end, as narrowed, so it never reads as every vehicle. A key ending _up, _down or _same carries a comparison with the same month a year earlier (or the same months, for a window); _alone is the sentence without it, said where the earlier period is missing, too small, not comparable, or spans a change in how the data is recorded (invariant 7). The words for what a dataset counts come from its own words (config/dimensions.json, leader_count) as {counted}. pipeline/tests/test_site_config.py holds every text here to config/narrative/rules.json (placeholders.chart_sentence).
values_up: {name} has the most: {counted}, up {change|pct} on the {prior_count} {prior}.
values_down: {name} has the most: {counted}, down {change|pct} on the {prior_count} {prior}.
values_same: {name} has the most: {counted}, the same as the {prior_count} {prior}.
values_tied: {names} are level at the top: each has {counted}.
mix_up: {name} has the largest share of vehicles {recent}: {share}, up {points} on the {months} months before.
mix_down: {name} has the largest share of vehicles {recent}: {share}, down {points} on the {months} months before.
mix_same: {name} has the largest share of vehicles {recent}: {share}, level with the {months} months before.
mix_alone: {name} has the largest share of vehicles {recent}: {share}.
mix_tied: {names} are level with the largest share of vehicles {recent}: {share} each.
parts_share: By {field}, {name} is the largest group: {share} of the vehicles counted {period}.
parts_share_tied: By {field}, {names} are level as the largest groups: {share} each of the vehicles counted {period}.
parts_count_tied: By {field}, {names} are level as the largest groups: each {counted}.
narrowed: {sentence}, among the vehicles this chart's filters keep.
